README.md:161:## LLM refinement (optional)
README.md:163:If you have [Ollama](https://ollama.com) installed, you can enable LLM-powered text cleanup. After transcription, the text is sent to a local LLM that fixes punctuation, removes filler words, and formats numbered lists — all on-device.
README.md:165:1. Install Ollama: `brew install ollama`
README.md:166:2. Pull a model: `ollama pull gemma3:4b` (small, fast, good at text cleanup)
README.md:167:3. Start Ollama: `ollama serve` (or `brew services start ollama`)
README.md:168:4. Toggle in the menu bar or click **refine** in the overlay
README.md:170:Refinement only runs on text longer than 50 characters. Short dictations are inserted as-is.
README.md:172:### Customizing refinement
README.md:176:| `~/.local-whisper/refine` | ON/OFF state (also togglable from menu bar / overlay) |
README.md:177:| `~/.local-whisper/refine_model` | Ollama model to use (default: `gemma3:4b`) |
README.md:178:| `~/.local-whisper/refine_prompt` | Custom instructions for the LLM |
README.md:186:./download-ggml-model.sh tiny
README.md:189:The system automatically picks the smallest available model (tiny > base > small) for partials while keeping your chosen model for the final transcription.
README.md:254:  → Optional LLM refinement via Ollama (punctuation, formatting, cleanup)
README.md:281:- **External keyboard mapping**: Some keyboards (e.g., Logitech MX Keys) send non-standard modifier flags. Try different `TRIGGER_KEY` values (`rightAlt`, `rightCmd`, `rightCtrl`) in init.lua
setup.sh:41:echo "  1) rightCmd     (Right Command)      — recommended"
setup.sh:48:    1) NEW_KEY="rightCmd";  KEY_LABEL="Right Command" ;;
install.sh:127:# Also download tiny model for faster live preview (~75 MB)
install.sh:128:TINY_MODEL="$WHISPER_CPP_DIR/models/ggml-tiny.bin"
install.sh:132:    info "Downloading ggml-tiny.bin for faster live preview (~75 MB)..."
install.sh:134:    bash ./models/download-ggml-model.sh tiny
AGENTS.md:12:  → whisper-cli (transcription — tiny model for partials, chosen model for final)
AGENTS.md:27:- `~/whisper.cpp/models/` — whisper models (medium, tiny, etc.)
AGENTS.md:82:**Rule**: Never add a new top-level `local` without first verifying the count stays ≤ 200. If the count climbs back toward the ceiling, group related state into a single table rather than adding bare locals — `finalizeTimers` (`{ timer, watchdog }`) and `ollamaProbe` (`{ value, at }`) are the existing examples of that pattern.
AGENTS.md:93:- `/debug` — check logs, config state, Ollama status, and recent errors
AGENTS.md:94:- `/test-refine` — run the LLM refinement eval suite
AGENTS.md:102:### Testing Ollama refinement without dictating
AGENTS.md:110:### Running the refine eval suite
AGENTS.md:112:./tests/test_refine.sh
AGENTS.md:115:Requires Ollama running locally — it calls the HTTP API directly and bails out otherwise.
AGENTS.md:163:- **Refine not working**: Check `refine: failed` in logs — common causes: Ollama not running, wrong model name, missing `$HOME` env
tests/test_refine.sh:2:# test_refine.sh — eval suite for Ollama LLM refinement
tests/test_refine.sh:3:# Tests that the refine prompt produces correct output for common patterns.
tests/test_refine.sh:4:# Requires: Ollama running locally with the configured model.
tests/test_refine.sh:17:MODEL_FILE="$CONFIG_DIR/refine_model"
tests/test_refine.sh:24:PROMPT_FILE="$CONFIG_DIR/refine_prompt"
tests/test_refine.sh:35:call_ollama() {
tests/test_refine.sh:55:        echo "ERROR: No response from Ollama"
tests/test_refine.sh:78:    output=$(call_ollama "$input" 2>/dev/null) || {
tests/test_refine.sh:79:        echo -e "${RED}FAIL${NC} [$desc] — Ollama call failed"
tests/test_refine.sh:120:echo -e "${BOLD}local-whisper refine eval suite${NC}"
tests/test_refine.sh:124:# Check Ollama is running
tests/test_refine.sh:126:    echo -e "${RED}Error: Ollama not reachable at $OLLAMA_URL${NC}"
tests/test_refine.sh:127:    echo "Make sure Ollama is running: ollama serve"
tests/test_refine.sh:130:echo -e "${GREEN}Ollama reachable${NC} ($OLLAMA_URL)"
